nodes.label: SplitPro (Go rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Self-hostable Splitwise alternative rebuilt as a single static Go binary with server-rendered thin-client UI; full parity except OAuth/OIDC (auth is magic-link + password), plus filtering and moving expenses between groups.

nodes.label: Single static Go binary
nodes.rationale: One binary, no CGO (pure-Go sqlite), go:embed assets keeps self-hosting trivial and the deploy footprint small.

nodes.label: stdlib html/template views (as-built)
nodes.rationale: As-built views use stdlib html/template instead of templ (a documented spec alternative) to keep the build self-contained.

nodes.label: database/sql query layer (as-built)
nodes.rationale: As-built queries use database/sql instead of sqlc (a documented spec alternative); includes cross-engine ?->$n rebinding.

nodes.label: SQLite (pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite)
nodes.rationale: Pure-Go driver, no CGO; default engine for the lightest single-file self-host with no DB container.

nodes.label: balance_view (derived balances)
nodes.rationale: Balances are never stored; a per-dialect SQL balance_view canonicalizes each debtor/payer pair, sums signed shares per (pair, group, currency), and UNION ALLs both directions. amount>0 means friend owes user. Per-currency.

nodes.label: Money as int64 minor units
nodes.rationale: Money is never a float; stored as int64 minor units and formatted only at render.

nodes.label: Expense/activity filtering
nodes.rationale: Description (* wildcard), amount range, date range, group scope; combine with AND; travel as GET query params; never affect computed balances.

nodes.label: Currency conversion (pluggable providers)
nodes.rationale: Frankfurter / OpenExchangeRates providers with DB rate cache; conversions create a linked expense pair using exact big.Rat math.

nodes.label: Splitwise import
nodes.rationale: Imports friends + groups (not expenses, per the reference) via a user-supplied Splitwise API key; idempotent per group.

nodes.label: Bank sync (Plaid)
nodes.rationale: Plaid behind a pluggable bank.Provider interface; connect via Plaid Link, sync transactions, convert one into a prefilled expense.

nodes.label: dev.sh / dev.ps1 task runners
nodes.rationale: Mirrored bash/PowerShell runners (build/vet/test/cov/vuln/image/trivy/scan/full); GitHub Actions mirror these same gates.

nodes.label: Hand-written CSS (as-built)
nodes.rationale: Compact hand-written CSS in web/assets/app.css in place of the Tailwind CLI.

nodes.label: Parity first (drop OAuth/OIDC)
nodes.rationale: Everything the current app does the rebuild does, except OAuth/OIDC sign-in which is deliberately removed (auth = magic-link + password); added: password auth, filtering, moving expenses.

nodes.label: Backend-heavy, GUI-light thin client
nodes.rationale: All business logic on the server; the client is thin - HTML rendered on the server and swapped over the wire with minimal custom JS.

nodes.label: Money is never a float
nodes.rationale: Store integer minor units as int64, format only at render; negative amounts allowed for refunds/corrections.

nodes.label: Balances are derived, not stored
nodes.rationale: Expenses + zero-sum ExpenseParticipant rows are the single source of truth; balances computed on the fly by a SQL VIEW. No stored balance tables.

nodes.label: Lightweight & self-hostable
nodes.rationale: Easy to implement, run, and self-host: a single static binary + SQLite (default) or PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Chosen stack (Go+htmx+templ+Tailwind+Postgres)
nodes.rationale: One static binary beats a Node+Next build: no client hydration/SPA framework, type-safe SQL matching the balance-view design, smaller deploy footprint - with no loss of features beyond the dropped OAuth/OIDC.

nodes.label: Alternatives considered (Phoenix, Rust/Axum)
nodes.rationale: Elixir/Phoenix LiveView (heavier runtime, less familiar) and Rust/Axum (fast but slower to build) rejected; Go + htmx wins on lightweight, easy, backend-heavy, trivially self-hostable.

nodes.label: User entity
nodes.rationale: Adds NEW passwordHash; hiddenFriendIds stored as JSON text on SQLite; role USER|ADMIN; the Account entity is dropped with OAuth/OIDC.

nodes.label: VerificationToken entity
nodes.rationale: Backs magic-link, email verification, and password reset.

nodes.label: Group entity
nodes.rationale: publicId (nanoid) is the shareable join link; simplifyDebts flag; archivedAt; splitwiseGroupId.

nodes.label: Group/FriendDefaultSplit
nodes.rationale: Default splits restricted to EQUAL, PERCENTAGE, SHARE.

nodes.label: Expense entity
nodes.rationale: int64 amount; soft-delete (deletedAt/deletedBy); conversionToId links a currency-conversion pair; movedFromId (NEW) links the replacement created by a move; recurrenceId; fileKey; transactionId.

nodes.label: ExpenseParticipant entity
nodes.rationale: Signed net amount (int64) per (expenseId, userId); rows sum to zero per expense.

nodes.label: ExpenseRecurrence entity
nodes.rationale: cronExpression, unique jobName, templateExpenseId, notified.

nodes.label: SchedulerLock entity
nodes.rationale: id, holder, expiresAt - DB leader election for the in-process scheduler.

nodes.label: BalanceView (SQL VIEW)
nodes.rationale: Canonical unordered user pair via CASE, signed sum of participant shares grouped by (pair, group, currency), UNION ALL both directions. Portable across SQLite and Postgres; get_balance_at_date() adds a date filter.

nodes.label: EQUAL split
nodes.rationale: share = total/n; remainder distributed one unit at a time via a deterministic seeded shuffle (seed from sorted amounts + expense date).

nodes.label: PERCENTAGE split
nodes.rationale: Percentages in basis points (100% = 10000); share = pct*total/10000; must total 100%.

nodes.label: EXACT split
nodes.rationale: Each share entered directly; must sum to total.

nodes.label: SHARE split
nodes.rationale: Integer share units, GCD-normalized; share = units*total/sum(units).

nodes.label: ADJUSTMENT split
nodes.rationale: Fixed per-person adjustment, remainder split equally: share = (total - sum(adj))/n + adj_i.

nodes.label: SETTLEMENT (settle-up)
nodes.rationale: System method stored as an expense with splitType=SETTLEMENT; excluded from category/expense filters; drives balances toward zero; movable.

nodes.label: CURRENCY_CONVERSION
nodes.rationale: System method: converts a balance by creating a linked pair of expenses (conversionFrom/conversionTo) joined by conversionToId; the pair is not movable.

nodes.label: Zero-sum signed participant convention
nodes.rationale: Payer stored as +(total - share), everyone else as -(share), so rows sum to zero. The whole correctness of BalanceView rests on writers enforcing this - enforce and unit-test it.

nodes.label: Debt simplification (min-cash-flow)
nodes.rationale: Greedy min-cash-flow preserves each node's per-currency net while minimizing transactions; no participant both pays and receives.

nodes.label: Filtering (§5.2)
nodes.rationale: Query-only, AND-combined; group scope, amount range, date range, description with * wildcard via lower(name) LIKE lower(pattern) (escaped %/_) so it behaves identically on SQLite and Postgres; never affects balances; state travels as htmx GET params. No new entities.

nodes.label: Move expense (§5.2)
nodes.rationale: Guided re-split as delete-and-recreate in one transaction: soft-delete original + create replacement with movedFromId; user must acknowledge the recalculated split. Reuses existing model plus one nullable self-reference - no new entities. CURRENCY_CONVERSION pairs and recurrence templates are not movable.

nodes.label: Golden Scenario
nodes.rationale: One large deterministic regression fixture: 5 users, 6 groups, 230 transactions across 2 currencies; exercises split engine, balance view, settlements, conversions, and debt simplification together.

nodes.label: Python reference generator
nodes.rationale: Executable spec that emits golden_scenario.json (inputs) and golden_expected.json (outputs); the same construction + BalanceView math is ported into a Go test.

nodes.label: Testing strategy (coverage gate)
nodes.rationale: 100% on split engine/balance view/debt simplification/currency math, >=90% overall; table-driven + property-based tests; data layer tested on both SQLite and Postgres; CI coverage gate.

nodes.label: Build milestones M0-M11
nodes.rationale: Milestone-by-milestone build plan (scaffold, auth, friends, expenses+split, balances+activity, groups+move, currency, recurring+scheduler, PWA+push, i18n, optional modules, hardening) with acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: Deployment (distroless + compose)
nodes.rationale: go:embed assets; multi-stage Dockerfile to distroless; SQLite needs no DB container (volume for file+uploads); Postgres adds a compose service; goose migrations on boot; scheduler gated by SCHEDULER flag.

nodes.label: app service
nodes.rationale: Builds from ., exposes 8080, mounts splitpro-data volume; SMTP optional (magic-link/reset links printed to logs without it).

nodes.label: Postgres db service (optional, commented)
nodes.rationale: postgres:16-alpine, commented out by default; uncomment plus depends_on and set a postgres DATABASE_URL to use PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: SQLite default (no DB container)
nodes.rationale: Default is SQLite with just a data volume - one command (docker compose up --build), no database container; Postgres is opt-in.

nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Fast gates on every push/PR and workflow_dispatch; mirrors ./scripts/dev.sh build vet test cov plus a report-only govulncheck.

nodes.label: gates job
nodes.rationale: runs-on ubuntu-latest; checkout + setup-go (go-version-file go.mod, cache).

nodes.label: build / vet / test / coverage step
nodes.rationale: Correctness gates are fatal - dev.sh dies on failure.

nodes.label: govulncheck (report-only)
nodes.rationale: CVE scan never fails the build.

nodes.label: Upload coverage artifact
nodes.rationale: Uploads scripts/coverage.out and coverage.html (if present) via actions/upload-artifact@v4.

nodes.label: Release workflow
nodes.rationale: On a published GitHub Release (and v* tags for a dry run): full gates, build distroless image, Trivy-scan, publish to GHCR.

nodes.label: verify job
nodes.rationale: Same correctness + CVE gates as CI: build/vet/test/cov + govulncheck.

nodes.label: image job
nodes.rationale: needs: verify; builds and loads the image locally so Trivy scans the exact artifact, then pushes on a published release.

nodes.label: Trivy image scan (gating)
nodes.rationale: aquasecurity/trivy-action; severity HIGH,CRITICAL; exit-code 1 (fails the job and blocks push) on any fixable vulnerability; ignore-unfixed.

nodes.label: Push image to GHCR
nodes.rationale: Logs in with GITHUB_TOKEN and pushes :<release-tag> + :latest only for a published release (lowercase ghcr.io path).

nodes.label: Distroless image build
nodes.rationale: docker/build-push-action@v6 with buildx and gha cache; built once and loaded for scanning.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: The project maintains a graphify knowledge graph at graphify-out/. Before answering architecture or codebase questions, read GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure, and navigate wiki/index.md instead of raw files when it exists. After modifying code, ask the user to run `python -m graphify update .` because that update is AST-only and incurs no API cost, keeping the graph current cheaply.

nodes.label: Build, Verify, Test Command Policy
nodes.rationale: Claude must not run build, verify, or test commands itself; it should give the user the exact commands and ask the user to run them instead.
